articles.preview_en: Artist Deana Lawson uses beauty supply store surveillance images to analyze power and personhood in her exhibition at the Gagosian in New York City In her essay The Oppositional Gaze: Black Female Spe
articles.preview_ru: Artist Deana Lawson uses beauty supply store surveillance images to analyze power and personhood in her exhibition at the Gagosian in New York City In her essay The Oppositional Gaze: Black Female Spe
articles.full_en: Artist Deana Lawson uses beauty supply store surveillance images to analyze power and personhood in her exhibition at the Gagosian in New York City In her essay The Oppositional Gaze: Black Female Spectators, writer and philosopher bell hooks explains that the relationship between Black people and the act of “looking” has been traumatic since slavery. Black people, many of whom are still subject to the constant surveillance that originated during enslavement, have historically been punished with severe consequences, such as lynching, for looking back at those who subjugate them. Despite these risks, hooks writes, they rebelled by secretly looking at white people, as well as their surroundings, rejecting the white gaze as the singular framework of reality. We can, as bell hooks writes, “interrogate the gaze of the Other but also look back, and at one another, naming what we see”. I thought of this analysis when I visited Edge Control, artist Deana Lawson’s latest photography exhibition at the Gagosian gallery in New York City. Edge control refers to the gels and pomades that slick the hairs along the edges of a Black woman’s hairline, but in Lawson’s exhibit, the phrase takes on an additional meaning. It’s at once a styling product for Black haircare devotees as well as a tool to examine the beauty industry, consumerism and how surveillance and race intersect.

articles.title_en: Singapore and Brunei Celebrate 50 Years of Defence Ties and Shared Friendships
articles.title_ru: Сингапур и Бруней отмечают 50 лет оборонного сотрудничества и крепкой дружбы
articles.preview_en: Senior officers from Singapore and Brunei highlighted how decades of joint training have forged lasting friendships as the two nations commemorate fifty years of defence cooperation.
articles.preview_ru: Старшие офицеры Сингапура и Брунея подчеркнули, что совместные учения за пятьдесят лет создали прочные дружеские связи.
articles.full_en: The Singaporean and Bruneian militaries gathered this week to mark a half‑century of defence partnership. Both air forces conducted a joint fly‑over and exchanged personal stories of collaboration during the ceremony. The partnership, launched in 1974, has expanded from basic training exchanges to sophisticated joint operations and intelligence sharing. Regional analysts note that this enduring bond strengthens Southeast Asian security architecture amid rising great‑power competition. International observers view the alliance as a model for other nations seeking to balance national sovereignty with collective defense. The ceremony also showcased new interoperability protocols that will streamline future humanitarian assistance missions across the region. Future generations of officers will likely recall this milestone as a testament to the power of personal relationships in safeguarding peace.
articles.full_ru: Сингапурские и брунейские вооружённые силы собрали представителей для празднования пятидесятилетия оборонного сотрудничества. Оба военновоздушных корпуса провели совместный полёт и поделились воспоминаниями о совместных учениях. Инициатива, начатая в 1974 году, выросла от базового обмена кадрами до сложных совместных операций и обмена разведданными. Региональные эксперты отмечают, что прочная связь укрепляет безопасность ЮгоВосточной Азии на фоне усиливающейся конкуренции великих держав. Международные наблюдатели рассматривают союз как пример для стран, стремящихся сочетать суверенитет с коллективной обороной. Церемония также продемонстрировала новые протоколы совместимости, которые ускорят будущие гуманитарные операции в регионе. Будущие поколения офицеров, вероятно, будут вспоминать этот юбилей как доказательство силы личных связей в поддержании мира.
